slices.behaviour: loadLocalEnvironment does nothing where there is no repository at all, rather than throwing. A built image has no pnpm-workspace.yaml anywhere above it, and the function is imported first by both apps through a bootstrap module, so the walk up for the repository root has to be able to come back empty-handed. findRepositoryRoot returns null there; repositoryRoot still throws, for the boundary walker, which only ever runs inside the repository and for which no root is a broken assumption rather than a deployment.
slices.failure_reason: TypeError: (0 , findRepositoryRoot) is not a function. Before that the behaviour under test was an unguarded throw: running loadLocalEnvironment from a directory outside any repository raised 'No pnpm-workspace.yaml above /private/tmp/.../nocloud, so there is no repository root.'
